name.la: Appendix ad defensionem declarationis cleri gallicani
name.en-US: Appendix to the Defence of the Declaration of the Gallican Clergy
name.pt-BR: Apêndice à Defesa da Declaração do clero galicano

description.la: Appendix ad Defensionem declarationis cleri gallicani. Editio Lachat (1865).
description.en-US: Appendix to the Latin Defence of the Declaration of the Gallican Clergy, answering objections to the Four Articles. Lachat edition (1865).
description.pt-BR: Apêndice à Defesa latina da Declaração do clero galicano, respondendo às objeções aos Quatro Artigos. Edição Lachat (1865).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Bibliothèque monastique (Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais), Wayback Machine
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXII, appendix.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
